crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The sample is identified as a legitimate Windows system component, `eappihost.exe`, which functions as a COM surrogate host for EAP (Extensible Authentication Protocol) plugins. Its behavior is consistent with its intended purpose, including initializing COM (`CoInitializeEx`), registering as a surrogate (`CoRegisterSurrogate`), and interacting with the Service Control Manager to query the status of the "EapHost" service (`OpenServiceW`, `QueryServiceStatusEx`). The embedded description string `"Eap Third Party Host Surrogate Process"` further confirms its identity. No malicious activities were detected.
